validity.population: synthetic homogeneous cells with conserved 200-molecule messenger and effector pools
validity.physiological_state: software verification only; no physiological state
validity.description: Two-stage receptor-to-messenger-to-effector activation/deactivation network compared through deterministic fractions and stochastic molecule counts.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Praezisionsmedizin, Sections 4.4-4.5, pp. 129-132
MEHLISSA Next M5.4 stochastic receptor-binding baseline
sources.role: named-stream SSA and population comparison pattern

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next ADR-0038 shared intracellular ODE/SSA network
sources.role: network topology, solver, and comparison contract

limitations: All topology, rates, molecule counts, receptor input, and thresholds are synthetic software-test values.
The receptor trajectory is prescribed and does not receive feedback from intracellular state.
Messenger and effector pools are homogeneous, well mixed, conserved, and contain identical molecules.
The network omits amplification chains, transcription, metabolism, spatial localization, and competing pathways.
The ODE/SSA comparison is numerical verification and not biological validation.
The response threshold does not yet release a drug, induce apoptosis, or notify a higher layer.
Population variation arises only from reaction noise and does not represent biological heterogeneity.
